results.rule: Asia-range breakout: the 18:00-03:00 range; a stop order above it buys and one below sells, accepted 03:00-09:00; stop at the far side of the range; flat at 12:00.
Asia-range breakout: the 18:00-03:00 range; a stop order above it buys and one below sells, accepted 03:00-09:00; stop at the far side of the range; flat at 16:00.

Pre-market range breakout: the 08:00-09:00 range; stop orders beyond it accepted 09:00-12:00; stop at the far side; flat at 16:00.
Narrow-range breakout (Crabel NR4): breakout v2 (09:00-10:00 range, orders until 12:00, far-side stop, flat 16:00), only on days after the narrowest 09:00-16:00 session of the last 4.
Narrow-range breakout (Crabel NR7): breakout v2 (09:00-10:00 range, orders until 12:00, far-side stop, flat 16:00), only on days after the narrowest 09:00-16:00 session of the last 7.
Volatility breakout (Williams): stop orders at the 09:00 open plus and minus 0.5x the prior day's full range, accepted 09:00-15:00; stop at the 09:00 open; flat at 16:00.
Volatility breakout (Williams): stop orders at the 09:00 open plus and minus 0.3x the prior day's full range, accepted 09:00-15:00; stop at the 09:00 open; flat at 16:00.

Failed breakout fade: when the first break of the 09:00-10:00 range (10:00-14:00) closes its hour back inside the range, trade the other way at the next open; stop at that hour's extreme, target the other side of the range, flat at 16:00.
Prior-day range breakout: when 09:00 opens inside the prior day's full range, stop orders at that day's high and low, accepted 09:00-14:00; stop at the 09:00 open; flat at 16:00.
Breakout v2 in rising volatility: only when the average range of the last five days is above the 20-day EWMA scale.
Breakout v2 in falling volatility: only when the average range of the last five days is below the 20-day EWMA scale.
Afternoon range breakout: the 12:00-13:00 range; stop orders beyond it accepted 13:00-15:00; stop at the far side; flat at 16:00.
Intraday momentum, later signal: the return from the prior 16:00 close to 12:00 sets the direction; trade at the 14:00 open, stop half the remaining range away, flat at 16:00.
Intraday momentum, later signal: the return from the prior 16:00 close to 13:00 sets the direction; trade at the 15:00 open, stop half the remaining range away, flat at 16:00.
First hour to last two hours: a 09:00-10:00 move of at least 0.25x the typical day range sets the direction for 14:00-16:00; stop half the remaining range away.
Trend vote: the signs of the 5-, 20- and 60-day returns (majority) set the direction at the 10:00 open; stop half the remaining range away, flat at 16:00.
Trend vote: the signs of the 5-, 20- and 60-day returns (all three agree) set the direction at the 10:00 open; stop half the remaining range away, flat at 16:00.

Gap reversal: when 09:00 opens at least 0.3x the typical range away from the prior 16:00 close and the 09:00 hour moves back against it, fade the gap at 10:00; stop beyond the 09:00 hour, target the prior close, flat at 16:00.
